SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'A', 3, 1, 3), (2, 'A', 2, 6, 1), (3, 'A', 1, 4, 2), (4, 'B', 2, 3, 1), (5, 'B', 1, 7, 2)) t(id, product, period, v, w) DECIDE x(INT), per (): y(INT)
        SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND per t.product: y <= at(previous: t.v) over (t.period within t.product) MAXIMIZE sum(x)
